name: an-alt-text-is-paired-with-its-neighbour
find: guard let alt = cap.altText(for: url, at: idx),
replace: guard let alt = (idx < cap.altTexts.count ? cap.altTexts[idx] : nil),
breaks: the export goes back to pairing alt texts with photos by position, so reordering a day describes every photo with its neighbour's words, which reads as plausible because alt text from one shoot resembles itself (#1008)
